scenes.tts: A newborn rat muscle fiber is wired to two or more motor neurons. Every one works. Within weeks, all but one are gone. What decides which stays?
scenes.visual: Title card: Quieter Than Its Neighbour. One muscle fiber with one endplate; three coloured axons converge on it.
scenes.narration: A newborn rat muscle fiber is wired to two or more motor neurons. Every one works. Within weeks, all but one are gone. What decides which stays?

scenes.tts: Each extra input releases acetylcholine and evokes an electrical response in the fiber. Nothing is wrong with them. Then they are removed.
scenes.visual: Each of the three axons flashes in turn; the fiber shows a small voltage blip each time, not a contraction. Then two axons fade, leaving one.
scenes.narration: Each extra input releases acetylcholine and evokes an electrical response in the fiber. Nothing is wrong with them. Then they are removed.

scenes.tts: How do you count them? Put an electrode inside one fiber, and slowly turn up the stimulus to its nerve.
scenes.visual: An electrode enters the fiber at the endplate. A stimulus knob beside the nerve, turned low. An empty plot opens: response size up the side, stimulus strength along the bottom.
scenes.narration: How do you count them? Put an electrode inside one fiber, and slowly turn up the stimulus to its nerve.

scenes.tts: Each axon in the nerve has its own threshold. It fires only once the stimulus passes that level.
scenes.visual: Three axons, each with a marked threshold level on the knob's scale: low, middle, high.
scenes.narration: Each axon in the nerve has its own threshold. It fires only once the stimulus passes that level.

scenes.tts: Predict. If three axons reach this fiber, what does the response look like as the stimulus rises?
scenes.visual: Question card over the empty plot: three axons; what does the response look like as the stimulus rises?
scenes.narration: Predict. If three axons reach this fiber, what does the response look like as the stimulus rises?

scenes.tts: A staircase. Each threshold crossed adds one step. Three distinct steps mean three axons.
scenes.visual: Separate pulses at rising strength; each gives its own small response trace beside the plot, and their sizes fill the plot as a staircase of three steps, coloured to match the axons, then flat. Label: schematic, not data.
scenes.narration: A staircase. Each threshold crossed adds one step. Three distinct steps mean three axons.

scenes.tts: One axon gives one step, at its own threshold. One action potential ordinarily reaches all its release sites at once.
scenes.visual: A single axon: one action potential spreads to all its terminals together; the trace shows one step.
scenes.narration: One axon gives one step, at its own threshold. One action potential ordinarily reaches all its release sites at once.

scenes.tts: In nineteen seventy, Redfern did this in newborn rat diaphragm.
scenes.caption: In 1970, P. A. Redfern did this in newborn rat diaphragm.
scenes.visual: Credit card: P. A. Redfern, 1970, newborn rat diaphragm.
scenes.narration: In 1970, P. A. Redfern did this in newborn rat diaphragm.

scenes.tts: Most responses at birth had two to four steps. By sixteen to eighteen days, single steps.
scenes.caption: Most responses at birth had two to four steps. By 16 to 18 days, single steps.
scenes.visual: Two traces side by side: at birth, a staircase of two to four steps; at 16 to 18 days, a single step.
scenes.narration: Most responses at birth had two to four steps. By 16 to 18 days, single steps.

scenes.tts: So did the extra axons' motor neurons die?
scenes.visual: The two lost axons trace back toward their cell bodies in the spinal cord, with a question mark over each.
scenes.narration: So did the extra axons' motor neurons die?

scenes.tts: Two measures tell these apart. Count the motor neurons, and measure one motor unit's share of the twitch.
scenes.visual: Two gauges appear: a neuron counter and a bar for one unit's share of the twitch.
scenes.narration: Two measures tell these apart. Count the motor neurons, and measure one motor unit's share of the twitch.

scenes.tts: A motor unit is one motor neuron and all the fibers it supplies. A twitch is the muscle's brief contraction to one impulse.
scenes.visual: One motor neuron lights up with all the fibers it supplies; label: motor unit. The muscle gives one brief twitch.
scenes.narration: A motor unit is one motor neuron and all the fibers it supplies. A twitch is the muscle's brief contraction to one impulse.

scenes.tts: Predict. If every fiber gives similar force, what happens to one unit's share if neurons die? And if they live?
scenes.visual: Question card over the two gauges: neurons die, or neurons live and trim branches?
scenes.narration: Predict. If every fiber gives similar force, what happens to one unit's share if neurons die? And if they live?

scenes.tts: If neurons died, and the survivors still reach every fiber, each keeps its fibers, so its share stays the same.
scenes.visual: Branch one of a split diagram: neuron counter falls; share bar stays level. Tag: every fiber gives about the same force.
scenes.narration: If neurons died, and the survivors still reach every fiber, each keeps its fibers, so its share stays the same.

scenes.tts: If neurons live and trim branches, the count holds. Each unit's share falls. This assumes the muscle does not gain many fibers.
scenes.visual: Branch two: neuron counter holds steady; share bar shrinks. Illustrative table on screen: 12.5% at birth, about 4% if neurons kept, 12.5% if neurons died. Tags: made-up numbers; equal force per fiber; fiber number steady.
scenes.narration: If neurons live and trim branches, the count holds. Each unit's share falls. This assumes the muscle does not gain many fibers.

scenes.tts: In nineteen seventy-six, Brown, Jansen and Van Essen measured both, in rat soleus muscle.
scenes.caption: In 1976, Brown, Jansen and Van Essen measured both, in rat soleus muscle.
scenes.visual: Credit card: Brown, Jansen and Van Essen, 1976, rat soleus.
scenes.narration: In 1976, Brown, Jansen and Van Essen measured both, in rat soleus muscle.

scenes.tts: Each unit's share of the twitch fell sharply. The number of motor neurons did not change significantly.
scenes.visual: Branch two lights up: share bar falls sharply; neuron counter steady. Branch one greys out.
scenes.narration: Each unit's share of the twitch fell sharply. The number of motor neurons did not change significantly.

scenes.tts: The neurons lived, and their branches went. Synapse elimination is branch loss, not neuron death.
scenes.visual: A motor neuron's arbor loses some branches while its cell body stays lit. Caption: branch loss, not neuron death.
scenes.narration: The neurons lived, and their branches went. Synapse elimination is branch loss, not neuron death.

scenes.tts: Here is the idea we will test through this lesson. A synapse is not removed just for being quiet.
scenes.visual: Guiding-idea card, first line: A synapse is not removed for being quiet.
scenes.narration: Here is the idea we will test through this lesson. A synapse is not removed just for being quiet.

scenes.tts: What puts it at risk is being quieter than its neighbours at the same junction.
scenes.visual: Card adds: What puts it at risk is being quieter than its neighbours at the same junction.
scenes.narration: What puts it at risk is being quieter than its neighbours at the same junction.

scenes.tts: The idea says which input goes. Overall activity sets how fast. Silence slows it, and some patterns of stimulation speed it.
scenes.visual: Two labels under the card: which input (the idea); how fast (overall activity: silence slows, some stimulation patterns speed).
scenes.narration: The idea says which input goes. Overall activity sets how fast. Silence slows it, and some patterns of stimulation speed it.

scenes.tts: Quieter seems to mean weaker transmission, as the muscle sees it. And it is a bias, not a verdict.
scenes.visual: Two more labels: quieter = weaker transmission as the muscle sees it; a bias, not a verdict.
scenes.narration: Quieter seems to mean weaker transmission, as the muscle sees it. And it is a bias, not a verdict.

scenes.tts: So the neurons stay, and each fiber holds a contest.
scenes.visual: Closing card: neurons stay; each fiber holds a contest.
scenes.narration: So the neurons stay, and each fiber holds a contest.
